card.line: Mesopotamia, the land between the Tigris and Euphrates rivers, is where Abraham's family lived, where Isaac's wife came from, and where Israel's enemies later came from.

moments.title: A servant seeks a wife for Isaac
moments.text: Abraham's servant travels with ten camels to Nahor's town in Aram-naharaim. At the well he prays, and Rebekah comes out with her jar before he finishes.

moments.title: Balaam hired to curse Israel
moments.text: Moses recalls that Balaam came from Pethor in Aram-naharaim and was hired to curse Israel. The LORD would not listen and turned the curse into a blessing.

moments.title: Cushan-rishathaim rules Israel
moments.text: Israel does evil, and the LORD sells them to Cushan-rishathaim, king of Aram-naharaim. They serve him eight years until the LORD raises up Othniel, who defeats him.

moments.title: Ammonites hire help for war
moments.text: The Ammonites send a thousand talents of silver to hire chariots and horsemen from Aram-naharaim and other lands. David sends Joab and the army against them.

moments.title: God appears to Abraham
moments.text: Stephen tells the council that the God of glory appeared to Abraham in Mesopotamia, before he lived in Haran. God told him to leave his country for a land He would show him.
